note: Held-out tasks captured from this repository's own history and redacted by hand: no token, no private URL, no user identity. Every body is shortened to the defect, so a loop can be scored on the shape of the work rather than on the full thread.

issue.title: the nginx header gate only inspects server-level add_header
issue.body: A location that declares any add_header stops inheriting the server set, so a sample with one header under location / passes the gate while serving none of the four. Expected: the check refuses that location and names it.

issue.title: the schedule console never says the scheduled half is paused
issue.body: A repository connected without a role still gets Run now, while every scheduled dispatch is refused with ROLE_REQUIRED and the page says nothing. Expected: one bilingual sentence on /repos/:id/schedule when repo_role is NULL.

issue.title: a runner without nginx records a gap and exits green
issue.body: The deploy check printed a gap instead of failing when the binary was missing, so a broken sample merged behind a green gate. Expected: a missing binary is a failure.

issue.title: the memory key field is editable while the entry is being edited
issue.body: Renaming a memory entry's key through the same form silently changes its identity instead of creating a second entry. Expected: the key is read-only while editing and named as such in both locales.
